errors.evidence: The description repeatedly states that the data lines start at N=1 (e.g., 'starts at around 94% at N=1', 'begins at around 86% at N=1', etc.). However, the plot clearly shows the first data point for all five lines is located at N=2.
The description states the red line rises to 99% at N=10, but the data point is visibly below the 99% level, at approximately 98.5%.
The description states the orange line starts at 85%, but the plot shows the value is approximately 83.5%.
The description states the green line begins at 84%, but the plot shows it begins at approximately 86%.
